//UnderworldDoor: Feature 30 (plan section 30, pack Prompt 43): the cairn is the door to the Underworld. Its action 'Descend Beneath the Cairn' is offered at night only (vanilla IsNight 413a4f94cfbfb8d4897c9dbf9dfbd49a at 1), takes no time (like the fairy ring, so no wild encounter can interrupt the step) and drops only the instanced CardType 4 hwenvunderworld, so each cairn opens its own copy keyed on the board it stands on. The way back is the realm's own exit card hw_underworld_exit. Forest Lore's Ancient Cairn gets the same action through GameSourceModify/fl_ancient_cairn.json, a soft row that resolves to nothing without Forest Lore. Derived here, so derive_content.py owns this block.

CardDescription.DefaultText:
A heap of stones raised over the memory of the dead.
Sit by it long enough and the Ancestors may come to you.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: At night, lift the capstone and go down the stair beneath the cairn, into the Underworld. You can stay a few hours at most: climb back whenever you like, and when the grey light fails the stair carries you up to this cairn.

FadeMessage.DefaultText: You go down beneath the cairn...

FailMessage.DefaultText: The blessing is not ready yet.
